# Windows line endings

This document uses CRLF line endings in every paragraph and list item. It describes a deployment checklist with explicit labels, Unicode names such as 札幌 and Québec, and a link to [the release notes](#release-notes). The expected answer preserves the source line ending bytes as well as the visible words, list hierarchy, and blank-line boundaries.

- verify the package
- compare the checksum
  - record the result
